title: A route's ``response_model`` is a read DTO, never a ``table=True`` ORM model
intent: :func:`check_routes_declare_response_model` proves a model is *declared*; this rule proves it is not the persisted table itself. A ``response_model`` set to a ``table=True`` model -- directly or wrapped in ``Page[...]`` / ``list[...]`` -- serializes the ORM row, so a column such as ``hashed_password`` leaks straight through the boundary (the ``Page[User]`` footgun). Return a ``*Read`` schema (:class:`terp.core.BaseSchema`) listing exactly the safe fields instead.
